title: The Vale of Ash
intro: The barrow on the hill has opened, and a gray blight creeps down the vale. Crops fail. Roads empty. The village of Last Light holds on at the wood's edge. Someone must go up to the barrow and end this. You walked in at dusk.

scout.name: Scout
scout.desc: quick and quiet; finds hidden ways

scholar.name: Scholar
scholar.desc: reads the old tongue; knows the rites

envoy.name: Envoy
envoy.desc: words open doors that iron cannot

descs: Ash trees stand close. Gray light, gray ground.
A dry streambed. Nothing drinks here now.
Burned ground where the blight passed. It crunches underfoot.
Old stumps and new shoots, all of them gray.
The path forks around a fallen ash.
Bracken to the waist. Something small runs off.
Leaning trees. The wind speaks through them.

spots.name: Gray Cairn
spots.desc: A cairn of flat stones, older than the wood. Travelers left charms here once.
onEnterOnce: Someone built this to be found.

spots.name: Herb Hollow
spots.desc: A sunken hollow out of the wind. Green things still grow here, just barely.

gate.name: Village Gate
gate.desc: The last gate before the wood. Lanterns burn all day here now. The square lies south; the Ashwood waits north.

square.name: Last Light Square
square.desc: Packed earth and a dry well. The reeve stands watch by the notice board. Inn west, forge east, chapel south.

inn.name: The Last Light Inn
inn.desc: A low fire, empty tables, and an innkeep glad of any face.

actions.label: rest by the fire
fx: You sleep without dreams and wake steadier.

forge.name: The Forge
forge.desc: Coals banked low. The smith works with the door open, watching the road.

chapel.name: Gray Chapel
chapel.desc: A small stone chapel. Candles against the dark. The priest wears ash on both hands.

elder_house.name: Elder's House
elder_house.desc: Ledgers, dust, and a sealed iron coffer on the mantel. The elder receives you without a smile.

hunters_camp.name: Hunter's Camp
hunters_camp.desc: A lean-to and a smoke rack at the wood's west edge. The hunter watches the trees, not you.

drowned_chapel.name: Drowned Chapel
drowned_chapel.desc: Half a chapel, sunk to its windows in black water. A stone psalter stands above the waterline.

actions.label: recall the water verse (scholar)
fx: The water verse comes back to you, line by line.

actions.label: work out the water verse
fx: The worn lines give up their meaning.
The water has taken too much. Try again.

watchtower.name: Old Watchtower
watchtower.desc: An old watchtower, stairs still sound. Wind carvings ring the bell room at the top.

actions.label: recall the wind verse (scholar)
fx: The wind verse comes back to you, whole.

actions.label: work out the wind carvings
fx: The carvings give up their meaning.

barrow_field.name: Barrow Field
barrow_field.desc: A bare hill and two stone doors set into it. The grass here is white, not gray.

north.lockedMsg: The stone doors are shut fast.

onEnterOnce: So this is where the gray begins.

actions.label: force the doors
fx: Stone grinds on stone. The doors open.

actions.label: search for the keeper's crack (scout)
fx: A narrow gap behind the ivy. You work it wider.
Nothing yet. The hill keeps its secrets.

antechamber.name: Barrow Antechamber
antechamber.desc: Cut stone, older than the village. Shelf niches stand empty. Cold air moves up from below.

hall_of_verses.name: Hall of Verses
hall_of_verses.desc: Every wall is cut with lines of old writing. Some of it almost reads itself.

up.lockedMsg: There is a stair here somewhere. The walls say where.

actions.label: study the stone walls (scholar)
fx: The stone verse reads itself to you — and names a hidden stair.

actions.label: work out the stone verse
fx: The verse comes clear — and it names a hidden stair.
The old letters swim. Try again.

crypt.name: Crypt
crypt.desc: Low vaults and stone boxes. Something stands between you and the north passage.

north.lockedMsg: The wight bars the way north.

actions.label: slip past the wight (scout)
fx: You keep to the shadow and slip by.
Claws rake you as you dart back.

throne.name: Throne of the Barrow
throne.desc: The Hollow King sits on a stone seat. Where a crown should be, there is nothing. The air is very still.

actions.label: speak the binding rite
fx: You speak the three verses. The king closes his eyes like a man finally allowed to sleep. The gray lifts from the vale by morning.

actions.label: return the crown
fx: You set the crown in his hands. He stands, bows once, and lies down at last. The gray goes out of the trees like a tide.

actions.label: kneel and take his crown
fx: You kneel. The crown of nothing settles on you, light as ash. The vale will have a king after all — and no dawn.

topics.label: the blight
topics.say: It kills slow. Crops first, then cattle, then the will to stay. It started the night the barrow opened.

topics.label: the barrow
topics.say: Seal it. Whatever is down there, promise me you'll seal it under stone, and the watch stands with you.

topics.label: the watch's aid
topics.say: Then take the watch shield. It has stopped worse than claws.

topics.label: rumors
topics.say: Verses, they say. One in the drowned chapel east of the wood, one up the old watchtower, one cut into the barrow stone itself. And the hunter at the west edge trades herbs.

topics.label: the old king
topics.say: He was a good king, long ago, and he was robbed in his grave. Grief like that does not lie quiet. Honor him, and doors open.

topics.label: a blessing for the barrow
topics.say: Go with the gray blessing, then. The doors will know it.

topics.label: steel for the barrow
topics.say: Take the plain sword — and hold still, I'll put a working edge on whatever you carry.

topics.label: the vale
topics.say: Four hundred years this village has kept the wood's edge. It will not end on my page of the ledger.

topics.label: the sealed coffer
topics.say: You ask about the coffer. The elder's hands close on the ledger.
fx: At last the elder unlocks the coffer. The crown is old iron, heavy for its size.
The elder shakes their head. Not yet. Find better words.

topics.label: the wood
topics.say: Wolves gone gray and wrong. Keep moving and keep iron close.

topics.label: trade for herbs
topics.say: Take them. Pay me by ending this.

ash_wolf.name: ash wolf
onDeath: The wolf drops. Its gray coat goes to dust.

barrow_wight.name: barrow-wight
onDeath: The wight comes apart into rag and bone.

hollow_king.name: hollow king

topics.label: why do you linger
topics.say: My crown. The first reeve took it from my barrow, and my rest went with it. Bring it back — or finish what the thief began.

topics.label: the blight
topics.say: It is my grief, spilled over the land. It will not stop while I wake.

onDeath: The king breaks apart into dust and old iron. The blight dies with him. The vale will not know why, only that the light came back.

walkthrough: be a Scholar — reads the old tongue; knows the rites
ask gray priest: the old king
ask gray priest: a blessing for the barrow
ask hollow king: why do you linger

king_slain: be a Warden — strong, steady, hard to kill

king_slain.repeat: attack hollow king with short sword

ask gray priest: a blessing for the barrow
